Built **Ridge Run**, a playable downhill mountain-bike racing game in `index.html`.

It includes a mountain course, four rival riders, steering, boost, and a shoulder-hit attack that stuns nearby opponents and earns points. The mobile layout has on-screen controls; desktop players can use the keyboard. Races end at the finish line with a place result and replay option.

Assumption: this is an original, lightweight browser game inspired by arcade downhill racing—not a recreation of the PlayStation 2 game. I checked the start screen and a race view at mobile size.
